description: Show the structure of one LINDAS statistical cube so you can query it: title, publisher, licence, status, dates, and every dimension with its IRI, label, role (key dimension vs measure), unit, datatype, min/max, and up to N example values with labels (sampled from the cube's value lists and observations). Use the dimension labels and example value labels as filters in query_data_cube. Example: {cube: 'https://energy.ld.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice'}, {cube: '<IRI from search_data_cubes>', examples: 20, lang: 'de'}.

cube.description: Cube IRI from search_data_cubes (or a visualize.admin.ch ?dataset= link)

examples.description: Example values per key dimension (0 = skip)

name: describe_data_cube
title: Describe a LINDAS data cube
